[Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 3>. The hand brushes slowly along the leaves, dew drops slide off and sparkle, the leaves sway in the breeze, while the camera drifts slowly along the leaves, one continuous move with strong, clear motion for the whole five seconds, never slowing to a stop.
